reason: JPX official guide states weekly publication is usually 15:30 JST on the fourth business day and explicitly warns year-end/New Year and Golden Week can be irregular.
jpx_regular_business_day_definition: exclude Cabinet Office national holidays/observed holidays
exclude JPX fixed market holidays Jan 2, Jan 3, Dec 31
standard_publication_date_rule: Fourth JPX regular business day in the calendar week immediately following the covered week.
earliest_signal_use: Next JPX regular trading day after publication date; no same-day execution.
irregular_week_rule: If the immediately following calendar week contains fewer than four JPX regular business days, classify PIT_TIMING_IRREGULAR and exclude the observation from the directional return panel.
http_last_modified_rule: May be used only as an audit cross-check for recent files; never as historical publication truth because archived files can be rewritten later.
